Name: Donut's SVE Seasonal Anime portraits (OUTDATED)
Author: DonutSteelPeas
Description:
I Love using the anime portrait mods by Ohodavi and even more-so I love using Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE) in all my playthroughs of Stardew but was always left disappointed by the left of compatibility between the mods due to the lack of anime portraits for the characters of SVE. That was until some talented artists such as BunBunz and Dawn created the Base Portraits required for these characters to fit in with my other Anime-oriented villagers! Unfortunately even less compatibility could be found for another must-have mod in my list, Seasonal Outfits - Cuter Aesthetic. Due to the scarcity of work done for this I decided to take it upon myself to provide myself and others with the SVE villagers neglected with Seasonal Outfits myself!

[b][color=#00ff00]I'm by no means an artist so hopefully you can overlook my work if it's shoddy, just wanted to make something satisfactory to me and hope you'll enjoy it as well![/color]

[size=6][color=#ffff00]Please consider using the New version I released (Complete with portraits of all SVE characters for seasonal cute characters):[/color][color=#ff0000] [/color][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30482]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30482[/url][/size][size=6]
[/size]
[/b]NEW UPDATE ADDING MARTIN AND ANDY!
NEW UPDATE ADDING MORGAN!
